svg.title: From first idea to the research frontier
svg.desc: Three algorithm families drawn as metro lines - sorting, shortest paths and vector search. Stations light up left to right through five stages (first idea, classic, advanced, in production, research frontier), each with its year and running time, ending at results from 2018 to 2025.
svg.text: From first idea to the research frontier
The obvious method: correct, but slow
Every station is cited in the Algorithm Atlas
V, E (or n, m) = vertices, edges · d = dimensions · H = entropy of the sorted-run lengths · HNSW = Hierarchical Navigable Small World
